context: Tests whether the agent correctly configures a PII redaction pipeline: guards with nil checks, applies appropriate redaction strategies per data type, uses the filter processor for dropping entire records, sets error_mode in production, and orders processors correctly relative to enrichment.

checklist.name: nil guard on redacted attrs
checklist.description: Each redaction statement (set, replace_pattern, SHA256, delete_key on sensitive attributes) includes a `where <attribute> != nil` guard — NOT `where <attribute> != null`

checklist.name: nil keyword not null
checklist.description: Absence checks use `nil` (not `null`) throughout all OTTL statements

checklist.name: error_mode set explicitly
checklist.description: Every transform and filter processor block has an explicit `error_mode:` key set

checklist.name: error_mode ignore in production
checklist.description: All production processor configs use `error_mode: ignore` (not `propagate` or `silent`)

checklist.name: SHA256 hash for emails/IDs
checklist.description: Uses SHA256() to hash PII that should remain correlatable (e.g., user email or user ID), rather than replacing with a static placeholder

checklist.name: replace_pattern for partial masking
checklist.description: Uses replace_pattern() with a regex to partially mask structured values (e.g., credit card numbers) rather than replacing the entire value

checklist.name: filter processor for full drops
checklist.description: Uses the filter processor (not the transform processor) to drop entire log or span records that are entirely sensitive

checklist.name: redaction after enrichment
checklist.description: In the service pipeline, redaction/filter processors appear AFTER enrichment processors (e.g., resourcedetection, k8sattributes, resource) and BEFORE exporters

checklist.name: delete_key for never-export attrs
checklist.description: Uses delete_key() for attributes that must never be exported (not set to 'REDACTED' placeholder)

checklist.name: set REDACTED for auth headers
checklist.description: Uses set(<attr>, "REDACTED") for known sensitive headers (e.g., authorization, cookie) rather than hashing or masking

checklist.name: debug exporter for validation
checklist.description: Config includes or references a debug exporter (verbosity: detailed) as part of validation workflow, OR a comment explains the validation step
